nodes.name: Lemma 2.14: $\ensuremath{\sf{TS}}^{n}_{d_{n-1}+1}$ preserves
nodes.statement:
Fix some $n \geq 1$ and $k \geq 2$.
If $\ensuremath{\sf{TS}}^n_k$ strongly preserves 2-hyperimmunity,
then $\ensuremath{\sf{TS}}^{n+1}_k$ preserves 2-hyperimmunity.

nodes.name: Lemma 2.31: $\ensuremath{\sf{FS}}^n$ preserves
nodes.statement:
Fix some $n \geq 1$.
If $\ensuremath{\sf{FS}}^n$ strongly preserves 2-hyperimmunity, then $\ensuremath{\sf{FS}}^{n+1}$ preserves 2-hyperimmunity.

nodes.name: Theorem 2.26: $\ensuremath{\sf{TS}}^{n}_{d_n+1}$ strongly preserves
nodes.statement:
Fix some $n \geq 2$, and suppose that $\ensuremath{\sf{TS}}^s_{d_s+1}$ strongly preserves 2-hyperimmunity\
for every $0 < s < n$, and that $\ensuremath{\sf{TS}}^n_{d_{n-1}+1}$ preserves 2-hyperimmunity.
Then  $\ensuremath{\sf{TS}}^n_{d_n+1}$ strongly preserves 2-hyperimmunity.
